checks.legal: CourtListener and Justia could not be searched directly: the network proxy refuses both hosts and the fetch tool refuses unsearched URLs (Oct. 14, 2026). A site-restricted web search of courtlistener.com/justia.com was run instead, plus news searches. News searches on the candidate's name (Oct. 14, 2026) found no lawsuit, charge, lien or judgment.
checks.foreign: 2025 and 2026 House candidate reports read directly: no foreign assets or income. FARA: exact-name search of the FARA bulk files (registrants, short forms, foreign principals), Oct. 13, 2026: no match.
checks.claims: Campaign site refused by fetch tool; iVoterGuide questionnaire unanswered. Sample = checkable claims in her Ballotpedia 2025 survey (6 rated: 2 true, 4 unverifiable).
checks.democracy: Never in office. News search found no statement on the 2020 or 2024 results.

networth.note: Assets minus liabilities from the 2026 candidate report (Jan. 1, 2025–Apr. 15, 2026).

note.t: One asset: Micron Technology stock in a personal investment account ($1K–$15K; dividends listed as $1,001–$2,500). Liability: joint Nelnet student loans ($50K–$100K). Earned income: salary as a university counselor at Grand Canyon Education ($75,000 in 2024; $85,000 in 2025). Both reports were filed Sept. 21, 2026. No foreign assets or income.

research_notes: Both candidate reports were filed Sept. 21, 2026, although her committee had raised $354,383 by July 1, 2026; likely late (the filing-year-2025 report covers to May 10, 2025), but no late-fee record was checked, so not scored as a violation.
